en.title: How long does a bike from China take? Read the four different clocks
en.description: Separate stock allocation, production, transit and assembly when planning a Chinese bike order, with dated Elves, ICAN and YOELEO owner examples.
en.intro: Two weeks shipping can sit inside a three-month purchase. The phrase usually answers only one part of the question you actually care about: when can I ride the bike?

sections.heading: Write down four milestones
paragraphs: First comes allocation: is the exact frame and cockpit available for your order? Next comes preparation or production, including any paint. Then comes transport, clearance and final delivery. Finally comes inspection, assembly and adjustment.

Ask the seller to attach its estimate to a milestone. Ready in three weeks might mean a painted frame ready for collection, not a finished bike at your door. Likewise, a local warehouse can shorten transit without resolving a missing cockpit.
Create a timeline with expected dates and blank actual dates. A useful order update changes one of those fields. A reassuring message that does not identify the current stage is less informative.

sections.heading: Three owner stories, three different bottlenecks
paragraphs: An [Elves order described in 2025](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html) reached dispatch after about ten weeks, while another owner in the same thread reported a much shorter overall wait in 2026. Custom orders and different periods should not be averaged into a brand promise.

A [June 2025 ICAN GRARO report](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135) described a roughly four-and-a-half-week arrival after missing EU stock led to China fulfillment. The important change was the origin of that order.

A [2021 YOELEO R11 build](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3237.0) described a long wait before dispatch and approximately two weeks in transit to Switzerland. Fast transport did not erase the preparation time. These are dated anecdotes, not a current delivery forecast.

sections.heading: Read scans, not just the tracking number
paragraphs: A seller can create a label before handing a parcel to the carrier. Look for the first acceptance scan, then the next actual movement. A gap between scans does not by itself establish loss, nor does a created label establish dispatch.

Ask for clarification through the seller when the stated milestone is missed. A concise message works well: the agreed dispatch estimate was this date; the carrier currently shows this status; please confirm the parcel’s location and the next expected action.

Keep the conversation and order evidence in one place. If a payment method has a dispute deadline, understand it when you pay and track it independently; repeated promises should not make you lose a protection window.

sections.heading: Plan the first ride after the build, not after delivery
paragraphs: Book workshop time with room for inspection and missing-part resolution. Do not arrange a non-refundable event around the optimistic edge of a custom-frame estimate. If the date matters more than the exact finish, ask about confirmed ready stock.
Keep your current bike usable until the replacement is checked and ready. A frame arriving on Friday is a nice development, but not a reliable promise of a Saturday century ride.

Your best delivery estimate is the seller’s current, order-specific timeline plus a realistic assembly plan. Forum reports help you identify what can delay it; they cannot turn uncertainty into a guaranteed calendar date.

zh-Hans.title: 从中国买自行车要等多久？先分清四段时间
zh-Hans.description: 用 Elves、ICAN 和 YOELEO 的有日期车主经历，区分库存分配、生产、运输与装配，制定实际交车计划。
zh-Hans.intro: “运输两周”可能藏在三个月的购买过程中。它通常只回答真正问题的一部分：什么时候能骑上车？

sections.heading: 写下四个时间节点
paragraphs: 先是分配：具体车架和把组是否已为你备好？然后是备货或生产，包括喷漆；接着是运输、清关和送达；最后是检查、装配与调整。
请卖家把时间估计对应节点。“三周准备好”可能只表示喷漆车架可供揽收，不是整车到家。本地仓也许减少在途，却不能解决缺把组。
做一张时间线，填预计日期，把实际日期留空。有效进度更新应改变其中一个字段。没说明当前阶段的安慰消息，信息量更少。

sections.heading: 三个车主故事，三个不同的卡点
paragraphs: [2025 年描述的一笔 Elves 订单](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html)约十周后发货，同帖另一车主在 2026 年报告更短等待。不同阶段与定制条件，不能平均成品牌承诺。
[2025 年 6 月 ICAN GRARO 报告](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135)描述欧洲缺货转中国发货后，约四周半到达。关键变化是该订单的起运地。
[2021 年 YOELEO R11 装车帖](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3237.0)描述发货前等待较久，运到瑞士约两周。快运输不能抹去备货时间。这些是有日期的个例，不是当前交期预测。

sections.heading: 看扫描记录，不只看单号
paragraphs: 卖家可能先生成面单，再把包裹交给承运商。看首次揽收扫描及之后的真实移动。扫描间隔本身不证明丢件，单号生成也不证明发出。
约定节点错过时，通过卖家询问。简明消息即可：约定发货估计是某日，承运商当前显示某状态，请确认包裹位置和下一步预计动作。
将沟通和订单证据放在一起。支付方式若有争议时限，付款时就了解并单独记录；不要因反复承诺而错过保护窗口。

sections.heading: 首次骑行日期要排在装车之后
paragraphs: 给车店留出检查和补件时间，别把不可退的活动安排在定制车架最乐观的预计日期上。若日期比颜色重要，可以询已确认的可发库存。
新车检查并准备好前，保留旧车可骑。周五收到车架是好进展，却不能可靠保证周六骑百公里。
最有用的时间估计，是当前具体订单时间线加合理装配计划。论坛经历能帮助识别延误环节，却不能把不确定性变成保证日期。
